info.name: FCourt — RUN ALL Local
info.description: Ordered Docker integration scenario. Creates isolated run records, asserts state/amounts/idempotency/authorization, cleans up only its own branch/court/staff. Demo owner/superadmin credentials required. No file uploads, external payment or real bank transfer. Stops on prerequisite HTTP failure. Walk-in requires enabled booking/hold counter gRPC safety servers; current default Compose returns 503 at that step until gRPC/TLS is configured. After closing time its eight dependent steps are explicitly NOT_RUN. External S3/PayOS/device flows are not verified.
